name: Disc Golf Masters
detailed_description:
TAKE YOUR GAME TO THE NEXT LEVEL IN DISC GOLF MASTERS

BECOME A DISC GOLF LEGEND

Take your skills from the local course to the big leagues and compete to become a true Disc Golf Professional. Challenge top players, refine your throws, and dominate tournaments to carve your name into the disc golf hall of fame.

REAL-WORLD COURSES & PRO PLAYERS

Experience stunning recreated disc golf courses inspired by real-world locations. Compete with pro-level players, each with their own unique playstyles, in both online and multiplayer matches.

THROW WITH PRECISION & STYLE

Fine-tune your throws with a realistic physics engine that captures the nuances of disc flight. Experiment with different discs, master different throwing techniques, and harness the wind to your advantage.

COMPETE SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Take on the world in online play or enjoy casual rounds with friends in local multiplayer. Play traditional stroke play, skins matches or test your skills in fast-paced arcade-style game modes.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYER & GEAR UP

Show off your style with a deep player customization system. Unlock new apparel, accessories, and officially licensed discs from top brands to make your player stand out on the course.

YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES

Create and manage your own disc golf league with online societies. Set up custom tournaments, define entry requirements, and build a competitive community with like-minded players.

Are you ready to conquer the fairways? Grab your discs and prove your skills in Disc Golf Masters!

short_description: Step onto the course in Disc Golf Masters, the most realistic disc golf game ever. Featuring the world’s top athletes, throw real-world discs on authentic courses. Start your pro career, refine your skills, and push the limits of the sport in the world's first true disc golf game!
